product_name.value: Bharti AXA Life Grow Wealth Ultra
product_name.quote: Bharti AXA Life Grow Wealth Ultra

irdai_description_line.value: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Savings, Life Insurance Plan
irdai_description_line.quote: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Savings, Life Insurance Plan

launch_or_version_date.value: files dated 2025-09 on bhartiaxa.com; brochure ADVT No II-Sep-2025-5753

value.name: Plan Option 1: Wealth Affinity Plan
value.description: Milestone Benefits every 5th year from year 10; premium allocation charge 5.5% falling to 3.5% (0% from year 6), single pay 2% in year 1

value.name: Plan Option 2: Wealth Plan
value.description: Loyalty Booster of 5% of the 60-month average fund value at maturity; no premium allocation charge

variants_or_plan_options.quote: The Policy offers a choice of two (2) Plan Options. The Policyholder must opt for any one of the following Plan Option at the inception of the Policy: I. Plan Option 1: Wealth Affinity Plan; or II. Plan Option 2: Wealth Plan.
variants_or_plan_options.note: option is fixed for the policy term

entry_age_min.value: 0 years (single pay DBM 1.25; PPT 7 and 10); 50 years (single pay DBM 1.10; PPT 5)

maturity_age_max.value: up to 99 (single pay and PPT 5 at PT 30+ and TA 99); 85-90 for PPT 7/10

policy_term_options.value: 10, 15, 20, 30, 40 years or to age 99 (100 minus entry age, minimum 10)
policy_term_options.quote: *TA 99 implies that the policy term will be equivalent to 100 less entry age with a minimum policy term of 10 years.

ppt_options.value: single pay; limited 5, 8, 10, 12, 15 years; regular (PPT = PT 20, 30, 40, TA 99)
ppt_options.quote: The Plan offers Single Pay, Limited Pay and Regular pay options to choose from along with cover till age 99.

premium_min_annual.quote: Limited/Regular Pay: Rs 2,50,000/- p.a. (for all modes)

premium_max.value: no limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
premium_max.quote: No Limit, subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy

sum_assured_rule.value: annualised premium x death benefit multiple (DBM): single pay 1.25 or 1.10; other than single pay 5, 7 or 10
sum_assured_rule.quote: The Sum Assured is defined as Annualized Premium x Death Benefit Multiple (DBM).

premium_modes.value: single, annual, half-yearly, quarterly, monthly (monthly through ECS only)
premium_modes.quote: The Premium Payment Modes permitted are single, annual, half-yearly, quarterly and monthly (payable through ECS only).

life_cover_multiple_choice.quote: * DBM is Death Benefit Multiple (as a percentage of Annualized Premium)

premium_allocation_charge.quote: The Premium Allocation Charge will be levied by the Company as a percentage of Annualized Premium.
premium_allocation_charge.note: returned at maturity (Return of Premium Allocation Charge)

policy_administration_charge.value: monthly % of annualised premium, varies by plan option, pay type and premium size (Wealth Plan has lower rates for AP of Rs 50 lakh or more); maximum Rs 500 per month
policy_administration_charge.quote: The Policy Administration Charge is subject to a maximum limit of Rs.500/- per month.
policy_administration_charge.note: table on policy bond p.19 is hard to read in text form; returned at maturity (Return of Administration Charge)

fund_management_charge.quote: The Fund Management Charges for Discontinued Policy Fund will not exceed the maximum cap prescribed by the Authority which is currently 0.50% p.a.

mortality_charge.value: per 1000 sum at risk by attained age, monthly; male table in Annexure IV, female 3-year age setback; guaranteed for the term
mortality_charge.quote: The rates of Mortality Charges are guaranteed to remain the same during the Policy Term.

value.regular_limited: same IRDAI-cap table as Wealth Pro: AP up to Rs 50,000 lower of 20/15/10/5% of AP or FV or Rs 3,000/2,000/1,500/1,000 in Y1-4; above Rs 50,000 lower of 6/4/3/2% or Rs 6,000/5,000/4,000/2,000; nil from Y5
value.single: SP up to Rs 3 lakh: lower of 2/1.5/1/0.5% of SP or FV or Rs 3,000/2,000/1,500/1,000; above Rs 3 lakh: lower of 1/0.7/0.5/0.35% or Rs 6,000/5,000/4,000/2,000; nil from Y5

discontinuance_charge.quote: Discontinuance Charge is levied on the Unit fund when the Policyholder opts for complete Surrender/Discontinuance of the contract.

guarantee_charge.quote: There is no investment guarantee offered under this Policy.

any_charge_returned.value: at maturity: all premium allocation charges, all policy administration charges and all mortality charges (excluding extra mortality and taxes); in-force policies only, also after revival
any_charge_returned.quote: Refund of Charges shall not be credited in case of a Surrendered, Discontinued or Paid-up Policy.

death_benefit_formula.value: highest of: sum assured (AP x DBM) less partial withdrawals in the last 2 years; fund value; 105% of premiums paid less partial withdrawals in the last 2 years
death_benefit_formula.quote: Death Benefit shall be the highest of: i. Sum Assured less any Partial Withdrawals made during the two (2) years immediately preceding the date of death; or ii. Policy Fund Value as on the date of intimation of death; or

maturity_benefit.value: fund value including all additions; no investment guarantee
maturity_benefit.quote: In case the Life Insured survives till maturity, and all due Premiums have been paid till the Maturity Date, the Policy Fund Value as on the Maturity Date will be payable.

loyalty_additions.value: Wealth Plan: Loyalty Booster at maturity = 5% of the average fund value of the preceding 60 months
loyalty_additions.quote: Loyalty Booster= Five percent (5%) x Average of Policy Fund Value of the preceding sixty (60) months prior to Maturity Date.

wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.value: Wealth Affinity Plan: Milestone Benefit every 5th year from year 10 = factor x average fund value of the preceding 60 months; factor 5% (AP < Rs 5 lakh) or 10% (AP >= Rs 5 lakh) before year 20, 10% / 20% from year 20
wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.quote: Milestone Benefit= Milestone Benefit Factor x Average of Policy Fund Value at the end of each of the preceding sixty (60) months.

return_of_mortality_charges.quote: c) Return of Mortality Charge: The total Mortality Charges (excluding any extra Mortality Charge or any applicable tax/cess levied) deducted during the Policy Term will be added to the Policy Fund Value at maturity.

return_of_premium_allocation_charges.quote: a) Return of Premium Allocation Charge: The total Premium Allocation Charges (excluding any applicable tax/cess levied) deducted during the Policy Term will be added to the Policy Fund Value at maturity, if any.

return_of_policy_admin_charges.quote: b) Return of Administration Charge: The total Administration Charges (excluding any applicable tax/cess levied) deducted during the Policy Term will be added to the Policy Fund Value at maturity, if any.

value.name: EmpowHer Booster
value.rule: female lives, at maturity: single pay 5% / 10% of AP (PT up to / over 15); other 50% / 100% of AP

value.name: ECS Payment Benefit
value.rule: premiums by ECS: 5% / 10% of AP (PT up to / over 10) at the end of the premium payment term; not for single pay

value.name: Existing Customers Benefit
value.rule: existing customers, at maturity: same rates as EmpowHer; women get only one of the two

other_additions.quote: Female customers will receive an additional benefit (known as “EmpowHer Booster”) which will be added to the Policy Fund Value at maturity.

fund_switching.value: unlimited free; minimum 5% in any fund
fund_switching.quote: The Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

premium_redirection.value: allowed for future premiums; minimum 5% per fund; not for single pay
premium_redirection.quote: Policyholder can choose to change the Allocation of future Premiums with Premium Redirection.

partial_withdrawals.value: after the 5-year lock-in; minimum Rs 5,000; fund must stay at least 120% of AP (25% of SP); not before the minor is 18; any number free
partial_withdrawals.quote: iii. The minimum withdrawal limit is Rs 5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only).

systematic_withdrawal_plan.value: Systematic Withdrawal Benefit: annual, from year 10, each up to one AP, minimum Rs 5,000; opt out once
systematic_withdrawal_plan.quote: SWB is an automated Partial Withdrawal facility which can be opted by the Policyholder.

top_up_premiums.quote: Top-up Premiums are not allowed under this Policy.
